nuggets.text: In Laravel 11, middleware alias configuration has moved from kernel.php to bootstrap/app.php.
Middleware aliases should be assigned in bootstrap/app.php using a withMiddleware function.
Use the withMiddleware function to alias middleware classes, such as 'role' => \Spatie\Permission\Middleware\RoleMiddleware::class.
